criteria.title: First page loads — Open Dispense History; latest dispenses appear in the left selector
Scroll loads more — Scroll to bottom; older rows append; loading indicator appears then settles
Select older row — Click a row that only appeared after scroll; detail matches that dispense
End of list — Scroll until no more pages; further scrolling does not spam requests
Short list — Encounter with few dispenses: no extra page fetches in a loop
criteria.blocker: Creating a test patient with < 14 dispense orders requires multi-step dependent API calls (patient → encounter → < 14 dispense orders) and UI navigation to find the specific encounter. This deep seed graph exceeded the practical time budget given remaining criteria.

seed_attempt.summary: Driver written with API seed logic for creating a new patient with minimal dispense orders, but not executed due to time constraints. The multi-step dependency (patient creation → encounter creation → seeding < 14 dispense orders → UI search/navigation) was impractical within the remaining budget. Existing test patient already has 20+ orders, making it unsuitable for the short-list scenario.

criteria.title: Error resilience — Failed next-page fetch does not clear already loaded items
No regression — Opening Dispense History or selecting items from the first page still works as before
